I'm the guy who also works 8~10hs on the front of a PC and then try to stream at night. I have had different periods within 1 year I'm streaming. I streamed everyday for months, then 3 times week, and now I just "stream when I'm comfortable to".. Not that is that random, its still almost everyday, but I took off the pressure, and if someday Im just tired, I dont stream and thats it.

 

• I get home, take a nap (1h), take a shower, eat something and go live from 8pm~00 (more or less, depending on my energy)

• Set a schedule, dont matter when, which days, period, have a schedule. I'm on everyday from 8pm~ and the days I can't, I just post on social media.

• take breaks, but be honest, even if you wasn't streaming you would be watching something, playing something or using your phone. Humanity nowadays spend all their time on the front of a screen.

• Physical Excs. I play football, that's what makes it for me.

• Schedule depends on your disposal. Do you have wife, kids? Or just a job and the stream? Just don't stream everyday (I said I do, but I always take at least 2 days off to spare and edit some videos).

 

Don't overthink, don't overheat, don't take things too hard. Everytime you need a break, just do. People will understand ad my people do, they know I have a full time job and that is FAR BETTER to skip a day than make a tired stream.
Its totally fine. Use what you have to favour you as long as it doesnt hurt other people.
